lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is narrowest in the anterior region and becomes progressively wider towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the second line from the posterior, splitting in the lower quadrant of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The four most anterior lines terminate before reaching the ventral torso boundary; the first and last lines are significantly shorter than the central cluster.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white circular spots are visible on the mid-posterior haunch in a low-density cluster.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two spots on the haunch exhibit a horizontal alignment parallel to the dorsal-ventral axis of the limb.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white patch visible on the lower neck; large, rounded ear structures with white interior pilosity.
